description: Authenticate a company-owned sending domain for CharterOps campaign email through Mailgun. Existing website and inbox routing stay unchanged.
variableDescription: %dkim_selector% and %dkim_value% are the Mailgun-assigned DKIM selector and public key. The selector must be variable because existing Mailgun domains have different selectors. %ownership_token% proves the specific organization owns the sending domain. %dmarc% preserves a valid existing sending-host DMARC policy or supplies p=none. %tracking_target% is mailgun.org or eu.mailgun.org.
